title: Kyle Pitts rips NFLers who skipped Rondale Moore’s celebration of life: ‘Fake emotion’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kyle Pitts rips NFLers who skipped Rondale Moore’s celebration of life: ‘Fake emotion’
sources.description: Kyle Pitts was taking attendance and called out those NFL players who did not show face at Vikings receiver Rondale Moore's memorial service on Friday.
